items.text: Explain the four cloud deployment models (Public, Private, Hybrid, Community) and give a real-world example of each
Describe the difference between a Data Center and the Cloud
Explain IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS with an example of each from AWS
Explain the AWS Shared Responsibility Model — what AWS covers vs. what the customer covers
Define virtualization and explain why it is fundamental to cloud computing
Explain how a hypervisor works and the difference between Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors
List the four types of virtualization (Server, Storage, Network, Desktop) with an AWS example for each
Classify any AWS service as IaaS, PaaS, or SaaS based on what the customer manages vs. what AWS manages
Apply the Shared Responsibility Model to answer: 'Who is responsible for X in AWS?'
Launched an EC2 instance and identified it as a Virtual Machine created by AWS virtualization
Recognize when a scenario calls for Public, Private, Hybrid, or Community cloud
Identify and explain at least 3 advantages and 3 disadvantages of virtualization
Answer: 'What is the customer responsible for on an EC2 instance?' (OS patching, application security, data, IAM)
Answer: 'What is AWS responsible for in the Shared Responsibility Model?' (physical hardware, networking, data center, hypervisor)
Distinguish IaaS vs PaaS OS patching responsibility — IaaS = customer, PaaS = AWS
Explain why virtualization enables multi-tenancy and isolation in cloud computing
Identify the AWS Nitro System as AWS's custom Type 1 bare-metal hypervisor used for EC2
